note: Joshua Tree NP campground in the park's interior, about 8 mi from the North Entrance; sandy sites tucked among huge granite boulders, with trails and rock scrambling from camp. Only about a third of the sites take a 23-ft rig (most are tent-only or under 23 ft), so check the site's length before booking. Water is at the Oasis Visitor Center in Twentynine Palms, 11 mi away. Generators only 7-9 am, noon-2 pm and 5-7 pm; wood and charcoal fires are banned June 1-October 1. --Claude
